adaptations: executor.js hosts the unchanged browser script in Node vm and pairs emitted key events with its own execution receipts.
runner.js forwards executed keys through the same immediate public action API available to the baseline.
No image processing, target detection, action-time correction, hidden environment state, or task-specific policy is included.

unmodified_files.role: Actual runtime action queue; model-owned absolute timestamps, IDs, versions and expiry.
Optional developer delay simulation utility; not used to impose latency in live runs.
